title: China just dropped a free version of Claude's most expensive model
description:
China just dropped a free version of Claude's most expensive model, so I gave it one ridiculous task: find 50 New York businesses with no website and build a site for each.

It spun up 150+ agents in parallel and came back with business names, contact info, a spreadsheet of results, and a custom website for every business.

The wild part? This new Kimi Work feature can deploy 300+ agents in parallel, so you're never babysitting one agent at a time. What would have taken ten tools and a whole weekend got handled in one workflow, for free.

Comment KIMI and I'll send you the link.

#kimi #ai #aiagents #automation #aitools #opensource #buildwithai #artificialintelligence #aiworkflow #futureofwork
